front.title: A Standard for Claiming Transparency and Falsifiability

abstract.t: This document specifies a Transparency Metadata Interchange Format (TMIF) that allows a distributed or confidential computing system to make standardized, verifiable claims about its levels of transparency and falsifiability. Modeled as a structured Endorsement within the Remote Attestation Procedures (RATS) architecture, TMIF provides an agnostic, schema-defined communication vehicle for claimants to declare how their security mitigations and policy governance controls can be independently inspected, reproduced, and verified by third- party evaluators.
